text: The Italian state controls Eni: the Ministry of Economy and Finance holds shares directly and through Cassa Depositi e Prestiti (CDP), together more than 30% of Eni's share capital.

source.name: Eni S.p.A.: Eni's shareholders (major shareholders updated to 22 June 2026)
source.quote: The Italian Ministry of Economy and Finance has de facto control of Eni SpA by virtue of interests held either directly or via the Cassa Depositi e Prestiti SpA (CDP).

additionalSources.name: U.S. Department of State: 2025 Investment Climate Statement for Italy, Section 7 State-Owned Enterprises
additionalSources.quote: oil and gas conglomerate Eni (2.0 percent owned by the MEF, 28.5 percent owned by CDP)
